options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: bandwidth
options.description: The total bandwidth amount allowed by this traffic shaper.

options.name: bandwidthtype
options.description: The scale type of the `bandwidth` field's value.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enables or disables this traffic shaper.

options.name: interface
options.description: The interface this traffic shaper will be applied to.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: qlimit
options.description: The number of packets that can be held in a queue waiting to be transmitted by the shaper.

options.name: queue
options.description: The child queues assigned to this traffic shaper.

options.name: scheduler
options.description: The scheduler type to use for this traffic shaper. Changing this value will automatically update any child queues assigned to this traffic shaper.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: tbrconfig
options.description: The size, in bytes, of the token bucket regulator. If `null`, heuristics based on the interface bandwidth are used to determine the size.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
